bear_case.summary: Allstate at ~4.5x TTM earnings is priced on a peak-margin year: H1 2026 net income $5.73B vs $2.70B H1 2025 after hard-market rate increases. Personal auto is turning soft (auto earned premium only +1.2% YoY in Q2), homeowners concentration rises (+11.4%), and Q3/Q4 cat exposure plus falling reserves mean earnings likely peak now.
risks: Personal auto pricing cycle turns: rate cuts/competitive spend compress margins
Catastrophe losses (hurricane season, convective storms) with homeowners premiums growing faster
Adverse reserve development as favorable releases flatter earnings
Earnings normalization makes P/E optically cheap
Rate/credit marks on investment portfolio in hiking regime
